Repoint a standalone prefab file (.bin) from a static TMP font to the Persian dynamic fallback. The file is not a bundle entry and is not repacked here: export the patched file and install it like the Bendy prefabs (MT Manager), verifying size + CRC. GUIDs are the 32 lowercase hex external GUIDs. Leave all four PPtr fields blank for a GUID-only repoint (Bendy warnings); fill all four for a GUID + material PPtr remap (Bendy subtitles). A partially filled PPtr is blocked, and a PPtr matching zero or several components is blocked too.
